in_marathi.name: Lavkesh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's grace, divine gift
in_marathi.long_meaning: Lavkesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Lavkesh is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Lav' (God's grace) and 'Kesh' (hair or divine gift). It is believed that a child named Lavkesh is blessed with God's grace and divine protection.
